killerTaleLog: [day 34] Kurt: The fire settles. Kurt has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sweeps Week — I put it down today." "The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche." "It circles, unhurried. It has seen this episode before — and it knows how it ends." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Heidi breathes "Say that again — slower." Katarina breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 34] Xavier: The fire settles. Xavier has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Kurt breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Kaloki says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 39] Hannah: The fire settles. Hannah has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Rut King — I put it down today." "He lowers the crown. Paws the earth once, twice. The whole forest holds its breath." "His chest swells. The inhale goes on too long — cover your ears or get behind something." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Giulia says "And you're still standing." Elodie says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 40] Sari: The fire settles. Sari has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Moderator — I put it down today." "It reviews you. 'Content noted.' A weak ranging chip while it decides." "'REMOVAL NOTICE.' Defiant or compliant — the hammer is coming down." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Katarina asks "Say that again — slower." Xavier says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 40] Hannah: The fire settles. Hannah has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sunback — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still and arches its back to the sun. The mirror-scales catch the light — the glare builds, builds — then it launches, blind-fast, straight at where you were standing." "The thick tail lifts off the ground, swaying once — then sweeps like a felled tree. A monitor's tail is a battering ram with scales." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Kurt mutters "We've been walking past those." Kaloki says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 42] Kaloki: The fire settles. Kaloki has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Callback — I put it down today." "It speaks — in their voice, saying things they said. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track. The wrongness is the telegraph." "It studies you — tilting their head the way they tilted theirs. It is getting better at being them." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Xavier breathes "So it bleeds." Hannah asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 42] Katarina: The fire settles. Katarina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Performance Review — I put it down today." "A red line draws itself across the ground. 3.2 stars. 'ASSESSMENT IN PROGRESS.' Do not be on the line." "It stamps the air. REJECTED. The word has weight." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Giulia breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Blanca says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 42] Katarina: The fire settles. Katarina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Union Rep — I put it down today." "'BROTHERS! SISTERS!' Allied monsters hit harder. The speech is the weapon." "'WHO'S WITH ME?' Help is coming." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Sari mutters "And you're still standing." Giulia says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 43] Katarina: The fire settles. Katarina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Grief Counselor — I put it down today." "It turns. On its brow, like a mask: YOUR FACE. It lowers its head. It is going to show you yourself, at speed." "You dodged — it WHEELS. A second charge, no windup, aimed at where you are NOW." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Hannah mutters "So it bleeds." Giulia says "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 45] Hannah: The fire settles. Hannah has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ducks in a row — I put it down today." "The hissing stops. The line leans forward — it advances, and contact burns." "Every beak in the line, one coordinated bite." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Sari breathes "Say that again — slower." Elodie says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 45] Katarina: The fire settles. Katarina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Tick — I put it down today." "It waits. The questing legs wave — the tell." "Adjacent = attached. No dodge. It's ON you." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Kaloki says quietly "So it bleeds." Hannah asks "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 45] Hannah: The fire settles. Hannah has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Chorus Line — I put it down today." "The music starts — an actual audio cue, 4/4, and you can feel the downbeat coming. The downbeat is the kick. Deafness breaks the telegraph but not the beat." "The count stutters — ONE-two-THREE-and— the kick comes on the off-beat, where your dancing feet aren’t." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Elodie says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Xavier says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 46] Blanca: The fire settles. Blanca has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Spool — I put it down today." "RECORD first — harmless, it watches. Then REPLAY: the reels on its back spin, and the spinning reel SHOWS what's loaded. Watch the reel, not the tape." "RECORD. The reels turn slowly, drinking in everything you do. It is learning the shape of your turns." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Kaloki mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Kurt mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 46] Kurt: The fire settles. Kurt has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Terms of Service — I put it down today." "The text on the scroll GLOWS before a clause activates — the glow runs along the words like a fuse. The telegraph is literally legible. Reading is the defense." "A new paragraph slides in at the bottom — §12.4, freshly inked. You definitely didn’t agree to this. You also definitely did." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Heidi asks "We've been walking past those." Elodie says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 48] Hannah: The fire settles. Hannah has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Kaloki mutters "Say that again — slower." Heidi asks "And you're still standing."
